Dear Base360 Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Growth Marketer role at Base360. Your mission to build the AI operating system for B2C brands resonates deeply with my hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web development, and my passion for leveraging AI to work smarter.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO and content for client sites, driving organic growth through keyword-targeted strategies. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented structured data and GEO techniques to improve visibility across AI-powered search engines—skills directly applicable to your growth goals.

I'm a fast learner, scrappy, and data-driven, comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. I'm eager to experiment across channels, build funnels, and scale what works. I'm also AI-savvy, using modern tools to accelerate research, copy, and automation.

I'd love to bring my entrepreneurial spirit and technical foundation to Base360 and help build the growth engine from the ground up.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Base360 Team,

I'm thrilled to apply for the Growth Marketer position at Base360. Your vision of becoming the AI operating system for B2C brands is exactly the kind of ambitious, fast-moving challenge I'm looking for. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I'm eager to bring my hands-on skills to a role where I can experiment, learn fast, and build growth from the ground up.

In my current role at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, giving me a full-stack understanding of what makes a website convert. I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console, so I'm comfortable living in the data and turning insights into action.

On my own project, mirook.com, I've gone deeper into GEO and AEO—implementing structured data, entity optimization, and llms.txt to improve visibility across AI-powered search engines. This experience has made me AI-savvy and eager to use AI everywhere it gives an edge, from research to copy to automation.

I'm scrappy and self-directed: I take a goal and figure out the how. I'm also a fast learner, picking up new tools and platforms quickly. I'm excited about the opportunity to own a growth channel end to end, run experiments, and scale what works. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and ready to contribute to Base360's growth in Europe.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of building something huge together.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
